message: Hi Alex, it's Priya at Ironside Auto Care, nice. Can you also build me a mobile app for bookings and run my Facebook ads while you are at it? Same price?
reply: Hi Priya, thanks for the quick reply! To clarify, we only fix websites - no mobile apps, no ad management, and no SEO/rankings work. Those would need other specialists. The $900 fix pack covers your site issues (we audit with AI tools, then review everything ourselves), with an optional $250/month care plan after. Happy to send the audit if that's useful - let me know!
